phase: ROADMAP Stage 4: deterministic DOCX font fallback / known-font detection and pre-export preflight report v1
summary: Added deterministic, stdlib-only DOCX font fallback and export preflight helpers. build_font_fallback_plan reports, per role (body/title/heading/latin), the requested font, whether it is in a conservative built-in known-font list, and an ordered de-duplicated fallback candidate chain, plus advisory warnings for unknown fonts. build_export_preflight_report aggregates method/version, the font fallback plan, the layout plan summary, the structured field summary, and export boundary warnings. Both helpers reuse build_docx_style_profile and are additive: export_docx output is unchanged.
implemented: backend/server.py: added _KNOWN_DOCX_FONTS (conservative built-in known-font list) and _DOCX_FONT_FALLBACKS (per-role fallback chains).

backend/server.py: added build_font_fallback_plan(style_profile=None) returning method=docx_font_fallback_plan_v1, known_font_list_size, per-role {requested,is_known,fallback_candidates}, warnings, and summary counts.

backend/server.py: added build_export_preflight_report(title, body, style_profile=None) returning method/version=docx_export_preflight_v1, font_fallback_plan, layout_plan_summary, structured_field_summary, export_boundary_warnings, and summary counts.
tests/test_docx_font_preflight.py: 10 unit tests covering known/unknown fonts, fallback de-dup, JSON serializability, preflight aggregation, and the additive export_docx guarantee.
tools/run_quality_gates.py: py-compile gate now includes tests/test_docx_font_preflight.py.
README.md and docs/ROADMAP.md document the v1 boundary; ROADMAP items for font detection/fallback and pre-export preflight report are marked done.
not_implemented: No font embedding, font downloading, or host-installed-font inspection.
No automatic font substitution in the exported DOCX (fonts are still written as requested).
No rendered screenshot, layout regression, model call, network call, frontend UI, or persistence.
export_docx output is unchanged; the helpers are advisory metadata only.
